; Detailed MiniMap - English
; Key = text, UTF-8. A missing key falls back to en.txt, then to the key itself.
; Name is how the language is listed in the menu.

Name = English
Intro = A detailed 3D map built from the world's real meshes: ground, houses, stairs, rocks, furniture.
Language = Language
Enabled = Map enabled
ToggleKey = Show / hide minimap:
PressKey = Press a key, combination or gamepad button... (Esc - cancel)
KeyNone = none

Shape = Minimap shape
Square = Square
Round = Round

SecIcons = Icons
IconSize = Icon size
IconFadeIn = Icon fade-in, s
IconFadeOut = Icon fade-out, s
AtOnce = instant
SecCut = Cutaway
CutCover = Cut away ceilings indoors
CutHeight = Cut height in caves and houses
Style = Map style
StyleColour = Colour
StyleVanilla = Vanilla

Grid = Grid on the ground
